text.autoconfig.brb.title: Better Recipe Book: Rebetterered Settings
text.autoconfig.brb.option.settingsButto:
§d--- Settings access ---
The settings button and recipe book can also be enabled through Mod Menu or brb.toml.
text.autoconfig.brb.option.scrolling.scr: Continue from the first page after the last page, and from the last page before the first.
text.autoconfig.brb.option.scrolling.ena: Scroll recipe pages with the mouse wheel
text.autoconfig.brb.option.alternativeRe: In the vanilla alternatives popup, show the result until you hover over a recipe to preview its ingredients.
text.autoconfig.brb.option.newRecipes.un: Requires world/server re-join to take effect
text.autoconfig.brb.option.newRecipes.en: Enable the little bounce animation when you unlock a new item
brb.gui.pin.add: Press %s to pin this exact recipe
brb.gui.pin.remove: Press %s to unpin this exact recipe
brb.gui.instantCraft.on: Right-click crafting is on. Right-click: one batch. Shift + right-click: maximum.
text.autoconfig.brb.option.recipeDisplay: Vanilla: cycle grouped recipes. Expandable groups: use + / − to reveal fixed variants. Show all variants: display every recipe separately without cycling.
text.autoconfig.brb.option.creativeDispl: Vanilla: show the normal creative inventory. Expandable groups: use + / − to expand or collapse related items.
text.autoconfig.brb.option.enablePinning: Pin the exact recipe variant with your configured pin key. Pins remain saved when pinning is disabled.
Right-click a recipe to craft one recipe batch into inventory. Shift + right-click crafts the maximum. Left-click places ingredients; Shift + left-click fills as many as possible.
Show a recipe book button that turns right-click crafting on or off.
text.autoconfig.brb.option.scrolling.ena: The mouse wheel changes pages only while the pointer is over the visible recipe book.
